criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 24 April 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 24 April 2030 (48 months after Closing).
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Ashcombe Technologies Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 18 August 2026 (150 days after signing on 21 March 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 2 October 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $31,250,000 but 20% of the $125,000,000 Purchase Price is $25,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (24 April 2027; 24 April 2030) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 30 March 2026 (390 days).
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (20% x $125,000,000 = $25,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $31,250,000.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
